text: The authors reproduce Irving et al.'s figure comparing the tree of possible debates to the tree of Go moves. They define their hypothetical truth-finding computation M as the expansion of that whole tree, with simulated human judges adjudicating every path, and require their debate protocol to reproduce M's outputs more efficiently.
title: Buhl et al. build their reference computation M on Irving et al.'s debate-tree and Go analogy
